task.title: Replace Settings page composition with the attached system UI design
task.objective: Apply the attached SpecterStudio system Settings composition, keeping every existing Settings control, permission gate, confirmation, persistence path, and offline behavior while removing orphaned cards and unusable grid gaps.

architecture: Change renderer composition and token CSS only; preserve the Settings route, schema, preload API, main-process store, permission gates, and persistence behavior.
Reuse existing Settings components, Hologram tokens, shared cards, dialogs, page-chrome actions, and responsive breakpoints.
Do not copy demo values, fake actions, remote fonts, or simulated system status from the attached HTML artifact.
accessibility: Preserve semantic headings and sections, control labels, accessible validation linkage, visible focus styles, responsive single-column flow, and reduced-motion behavior.
offline: Do not add dependencies, remote assets, scripts, fonts, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: Settings uses the attached system design's icon-led Appearance and Environment and packaging hierarchy, with compact aligned card groups and no orphan half-width cards or row-height whitespace at desktop widths.

Every existing Settings control, permission gate, confirmation, immediate-save path, batched Save path, diagnostics action, import/export path, and validation message remains wired to its existing handler and preload channel.
The task records accurate AI-memory and roadmap evidence before terminal closeout.
